verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. The caller audit now derives PR-triggered roots from every .yml/.yaml workflow, follows local reusable-workflow calls transitively, fails closed when an on block cannot be found, and includes a regression fixture proving reachability through an intermediate caller outside the prior hand-maintained Rust-CI list. The release-only entries are also checked for direct PR triggers and verified through the selector's real allowlist path. The focused 10-test release-only and selection suite passes.
